model: unified v6: backbone unified_back6.onnx = MobileNetV3-Small (exp9 fine-tuned blocks features[10],[11], further fine-tuned end-to-end on the v6 dataset: 150-242 train, curtain de-loop + terminal quiet negatives), 192-d per frame; head unified_head6.onnx = 2-layer causal GRU (hidden 128) over 30 steps of [feat 192 | aux 15]. v6 combo slot relabeled: gap-to-next-segment bins 0 bg | 1 single | 2-7 bins [8-13][14-19][20-23][24-27][28-33][34-40] | 8 end (combo_v6.py); head combo = MLP. IMPORTANT: head6 requires back6; switch both together (comboV6:true in dufu.js).

inputs.name: img
inputs.note: DETERMINISTICALLY UNUSED by the head (verified identical out for different img); pass the current frame. For the BACKBONE this is the input (roi [120,30,840,530], size 96, rgb, 0-1).

inputs.name: seq
inputs.note: 30 steps oldest..current, each [192 backbone features | 15 aux]; see aux below

output.name: out
output.note: concat heads in canonical order; slices below; apply softmax per head if probs wanted

normalization.dt33: realized dt between consecutive kept frames / 33.33, clip 0.5..3; first step = 1.0
normalization.since_parry: frames since last parry press / 3.0, cap 10 (0.1s units), 10 when none yet
normalization.press_last3: 1 if any of the last 3 frames (t-2..t) had a press from any of the 4 buttons, else 0
normalization.since_ok: frames since last successful parry (ok contact) / 3.0, cap 10
normalization.flare: 1 if raw flare flag of the current frame

aux.note: exactly as the dataset stores them; the runtime must reproduce these columns. Column 0 is written per window from the realized capture dt.

window.note: runtime keeps the last 30 captured frames 1:1 (irregular ~35ms); feed them oldest..current.

device_calls.name: head
device_calls.out: out: 77-d (see slices); image is a dummy — the head ignores it

provenance.def_note: trained with v3/v4/v5 hygiene: def curtain(3) -> unknown(4); output slices/labels unchanged
provenance.data_note: 150-242 train; v6 combo targets = gap-to-next-segment bins (only supervised from each segment's contact on; see combo_v6.py); 219-232 tell-derived curtain dropped from truth; terminal frames quiet negatives
